verdict.rationale: Gemini's first-party Connected Apps feature links Gemini to other apps so it can summarize Gmail, create Calendar events, and search content across productivity apps. Deep Research can also use personal Gmail and Drive as sources, so email, calendar and cloud drive are all covered by the product itself. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Drive search in normal (non-Deep Research) chat, independent or hands-on corroboration, and Connected Apps does not work in Gemini in Google Messages.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Gemini Apps can connect to other apps to complete your request and give you more helpful responses.
Summarize emails from Gmail, create events in Google Calendar or third-party apps, or search for content across a variety of productivity apps.
You can change or add other sources, like your personal Gmail or Drive, for your research.
